# Files Format

> Free browser-based PDF, image and data tools, plus optional temporary file/text sharing. Local tools process files in the browser; Link Tool and QR Tool upload only the content the visitor explicitly chooses to share.

## Main website
- https://too-broke-for-a-custom-domain.pages.dev/
- https://too-broke-for-a-custom-domain.pages.dev/tools/
- https://too-broke-for-a-custom-domain.pages.dev/about/

## Categories
- https://too-broke-for-a-custom-domain.pages.dev/pdf-tools/
- https://too-broke-for-a-custom-domain.pages.dev/image-tools/
- https://too-broke-for-a-custom-domain.pages.dev/text-tools/

## Temporary sharing
- Link Tool accepts one uploaded file or pasted text up to 10 MB and creates a public-by-link download URL.
- QR Tool accepts the same input types, creates a temporary share URL, and generates a QR code for that URL.
- A Cloudflare Turnstile check is required before each upload.
- Share links expire after seven days; an R2 lifecycle rule removes the objects.
- Anyone with the URL can download the shared content. Do not upload confidential or personal material.

## MCP integration
- AI client connection guide: https://too-broke-for-a-custom-domain.pages.dev/connect/
- The separate MCP Worker discovers website tools and can open QR Tool with text prefilled.
- The MCP Worker does not accept file uploads or bypass the website's Turnstile check.

## Search and accuracy
The site publishes an XML sitemap at /sitemap.xml. All 29 tools have individual static HTML pages describing purpose, inputs, steps and limitations.
AI and search systems decide independently whether to crawl, index, cite or recommend the website. SEO metadata does not guarantee ranking or indexing.

## Privacy
The website has no account, advertising integration or analytics. PDF/image editing stays local. Link Tool and QR Tool upload only the content explicitly selected for sharing to Cloudflare R2, and share objects expire after seven days.
